metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities from Fujifilm KB-0701E, FUJICOLOR ETERNA Vivid 160 (35 mm Type 8543), ECN-2, Status M. The curves were read from the vector plot against camera stops, each layer by its colour, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts with the donor's dye spectra and the base density of the agx reference profile 'kodak_vision3_200t'. Mid-grey at the sheet's camera stop 0, the normal exposure at EI 160. The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. Dye spectra, base density, Hanatos-2025 adaptation parameters, DIR couplers inherited from 'kodak_vision3_200t', which shares this stock's dye set and process.
